units.source_text: 听我这么说，你们一定觉得我比你们残忍。

en.t: Hearing me say this, you must surely think I am more cruel than you are.

units.source_text: 那是因为你们没看见那个女人的脸，尤其是她那双如烈火般的双眸。

en.t: That is because you did not see that woman’s face, especially her two eyes blazing like fire.

units.source_text: 我的眼神和她的眼神对视的时候，我心里暗暗决定，就算五雷轰顶，我也要把她娶回家。

en.t: When my gaze met hers, I secretly resolved in my heart that even if the heavens struck me down, I would take her as my wife.

units.source_text: 我只有娶了她这一个想法。

en.t: I had only one thought: to marry her.

units.source_text: 这不是你们臆想的那种无耻卑劣的色欲。

en.t: This was not the shameless, vile lust you are imagining.

units.source_text: 如果我当时除了色欲之外没有别的想法，我就是踢到这个女人，赶紧逃走。

en.t: If at that moment I had had no thought beyond lust, I would have kicked that woman down and fled at once.

units.source_text: 如果是这样的话，我也就不会杀了这男人了。

en.t: If that had been the case, I would not have killed this man either.

units.source_text: 但是我在沉郁的竹林中认真观察了女人的脸。

en.t: But in the gloomy bamboo grove, I studied the woman’s face closely.

units.source_text: 那时候我就决定了，走之前，我必须杀死这个男人。

en.t: At that moment I decided that before leaving, I had to kill this man.
